'''Wooof''' was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] in the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], working as one of the crime lord's best [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Wooof was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was a freelance [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], until he found himself in debt to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in the early [[Era of Rebellion/Legends|Rebellion era]]. As a result, Wooof became one of Jabba's perpetually indentured servants,<ref name="Galactic Files" /> living in his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]]<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Action Figure Collection]]''</ref> on Tatooine.<ref name="RotJ" /> He piloted a manner of [[Starship/Legends|spacecrafts]]<ref name="Galactic Files" /> and served as a [[Skiff guard/Legends|skiff guard]] for the Hutt.<ref name="JKTCG">{{JKTCG|set=Masters of the Force|cardname=Klaatu|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/mastersoftheforce/large/32klaatuniktoskiffguard.html}}</ref> Wooof was one of Jabba's best pilots,<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Wooof}}</ref> earning the honor<ref name="WhosWho" /> of flying Jabba's [[Yacht/Legends|space yacht]],<ref name="CCG" /> the ''[[Star Jewel/Legends|Star Jewel]]''.<ref name="CCGSJ">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Jabba's Space Cruiser}}</ref> The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] also occasionally piloted an [[AST-5 Armored Sentinel Transport]].<ref name="Offscreen">{{SW|url=news/offscreen-but-not-forgotten-mini-rigs-body-rigs-and-other-kenner-vehicles|text=Offscreen, but Not Forgotten: Mini-Rigs, Body-Rigs, and Other Kenner Vehicles|int=Offscreen, but Not Forgotten: Mini-Rigs, Body-Rigs, and Other Kenner Vehicles|nolive=1}}</ref>

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Wooof was in Jabba's throne room, sitting in an alcove with the [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] [[Tanus Spijek/Legends|Tanus Spijek]], when Luke Skywalker, let in by a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind-tricked]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], arrived to negotiate the release of Solo. Wooof and other members of Jabba's court surrounded Skywalker as he demanded that his allies be set free. Jabba was not interested in Skywalker's proposal, and Skywalker used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to take [[Nizuc Bek/Legends|Nizuc Bek]]'s [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol]]. The Hutt, however, opened the trapdoor of the throne room, and Skywalker fell into the pit of [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]]. Skywalker prevailed in the fight against the Rancor. Along with the Human guard [[Fozec/Legends|Fozec]], Wooof retrieved Skywalker, Solo and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to bring them into the throne room, pointing a DL-18 Blaster Pistol<ref name="RotJ" /> and leering at Skywalker<ref name="WhosWho">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> while Jabba sentenced them to execution. After Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca were sentenced, Wooof and Fozec escorted Chewbacca out of the throne room and left with the rest of the court.<ref name="RotJ" />

When Skywalker was captured and sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]], along with his allies, in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Pit of Carkoon]], Wooof observed the execution from the lower deck of the barge, taking refreshments served by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="RotJ" /> As Skywalker [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|escaped]] and boarded the [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]], Wooof rushed to the upper deck, charging the Jedi Knight alongside the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]],<ref name="Thok">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-2|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> and was killed<ref name="Galactic Files" /> by his own [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, deflected back at him by his Skywalker's [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="RotJ" /> 

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Wooof_btm.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Wooof]]
Though he flew the ''Star Jewel'', Wooof preferred to fly combat starfighters.<ref name="CCG" /> He had green skin, black eyes, clawed fingers,<ref name="RotJ" /> and was considered to be rather ugly.<ref name="ROTJW65">[[Return of the Jedi Weekly 65|''Return of the Jedi Weekly'' 65]]</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
Wooof was one of Jabba's best pilots.<ref name="CCG" /> The Nikto had slightly above average intelligence and fighting ability, average strength and speed, and low diplomacy. He was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive.]]<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Equipment==
Wooof wielded both a [[BD-1 Cutter vibro-ax/Legends|BD-1 Cutter vibro-ax]] and a DL-18 Blaster Pistol.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#024: Wooof|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TVC24wooof.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Green Nikto seen in Jabba's palace was called Klaatu, though Wooof was one of the production names used for this character.|[[Leland Chee]]'s original statement, later revised by ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''|<ref name="Chee">{{Blog|holocron|29/comments|Mistaken Identities}}</ref>}}
[[File:Klaatuccg.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Wooof in profile, misidentified as [[Klaatu/Legends|Klaatu]] by the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].]]
Wooof was played by [[Michael Stevens]], the same actor who portrayed [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]].<ref name="From Star Wars to Jedi: The Making of a Saga">''[[From Star Wars to Jedi: The Making of a Saga]]''</ref> The [[1998]] ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] used the character's image for cards depicting both Wooof<ref name="CCG" /> and Klaatu.<ref name="CCGKlaatu">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Klaatu}}</ref> The [[2001]] [[Masters of the Force (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Masters of the Force'']] expansion of Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game|''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game]] likewse identified this character as "Klaatu."<ref name="JKTCG">{{JKTCG|set=Masters of the Force|cardname=Klaatu|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/mastersoftheforce/large/32klaatuniktoskiffguard.html}}</ref> In a [[2006]] [[Star Wars: Blogs|blog post]], [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]] identified the Kadas'sa'Nikto seen in Jabba's throne room wearing [[Kama/Legends|kama]]-like fur clothing as "Klaatu", while acknowledging "Wooof" as a name used for the character during the production of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Chee" /> In [[2008]], ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' revised the characters' naming by identifying Wooof as the Kadas'sa'Nikto<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|334|Wooof}}</ref> called both Wooof<ref name="CCG" /> and Klaatu in the Customizable Card Game,<ref name="CCGKlaatu" /> and Klaatu as the Kadas'sa'Nikto<ref name="CSWE Klaatu">{{CSWECite|II|221|Klaatu}}</ref> that the same card game had identified as [[Yotts Orren]].<ref name="CCGYotts">{{CCG|set=Tatooine Limited|cardname=Yotts Orren}}</ref>

The "Klaatu" action figure made by [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] in [[1983]] is based on Wooof's likeness.<ref name="KennerW">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (toy line)|pack=Klaatu|link=VINtKlaatu.asp}}</ref> In the same year, Kenner also produced a "Klaatu (in Skiff Guard Outfit)" action figure which bears the likeness of the real [[Klaatu]].<ref name="KennerK">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (toy line)|pack=Klaatu (in Skiff Guard Outfit)|link=vintklaatuskiff.asp}}</ref> A new Wooof action figure, bearing the correct apparel and name, was included as part of the [[2010]] [[Hasbro]] [[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|The Vintage Collection]] line.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#024: Wooof|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TVC24wooof.asp}}</ref>
